description: This file contains utility functions for managing network interfaces, including creation and deletion of tap interfaces, Ethernet interfaces, bridges, and configuring IP tables and dnsmasq services. It is part of a system related to network configuration for Android virtualization.

methods.name: int RunExternalCommand(const std::string & command)
methods.description: Executes a given command string in the shell and returns its exit status.

methods.name: bool AddTapIface(const std::string & name)
methods.description: Adds a tap network interface.

methods.name: bool ShutdownIface(const std::string & name)
methods.description: Sets the specified network interface down.

methods.name: bool BringUpIface(const std::string & name)
methods.description: Brings up the specified network interface.

methods.name: bool CreateEthernetIface(const std::string & name,const std::string & bridge_name,bool has_ipv4_bridge,bool has_ipv6_bridge,bool use_ebtables_legacy)
methods.description: Creates and configures a new Ethernet interface with optional IPv4 and IPv6 bridged settings.

methods.name: std::string MobileGatewayName(const std::string & ipaddr,uint16_t id)
methods.description: Generates a gateway name based on IP address and ID.

methods.name: std::string MobileNetworkName(const std::string & ipaddr,const std::string & netmask,uint16_t id)
methods.description: Generates a network name based on IP address, netmask, and ID.

methods.name: bool CreateMobileIface(const std::string & name,uint16_t id,const std::string & ipaddr)
methods.description: Creates a mobile network interface with associated gateway and IP configurations.

methods.name: bool DestroyMobileIface(const std::string & name,uint16_t id,const std::string & ipaddr)
methods.description: Destroys a mobile network interface and associated configurations.

methods.name: bool AddGateway(const std::string & name,const std::string & gateway,const std::string & netmask)
methods.description: Adds a gateway route to a network interface.

methods.name: bool DestroyGateway(const std::string & name,const std::string & gateway,const std::string & netmask)
methods.description: Removes a gateway route from a network interface.

methods.name: bool DestroyEthernetIface(const std::string & name,bool has_ipv4_bridge,bool has_ipv6_bridge,bool use_ebtables_legacy)
methods.description: Removes an Ethernet interface and associated bridging strategies.

methods.name: void CleanupEthernetIface(const std::string & name,const EthernetNetworkConfig & config)
methods.description: Cleans up network configurations for an Ethernet interface.

methods.name: bool CreateEbtables(const std::string & name,bool use_ipv4,bool use_ebtables_legacy)
methods.description: Sets up ebtables rules for network filtering and bridging.

methods.name: bool DestroyEbtables(const std::string & name,bool use_ipv4,bool use_ebtables_legacy)
methods.description: Removes ebtables rules applied for bridging.

methods.name: bool EbtablesBroute(const std::string & name,bool use_ipv4,bool add,bool use_ebtables_legacy)
methods.description: Configures ebtables broute table rules for IPv4 or IPv6.

methods.name: bool EbtablesFilter(const std::string & name,bool use_ipv4,bool add,bool use_ebtables_legacy)
methods.description: Configures ebtables filter table rules for IPv4 or IPv6.

methods.name: bool LinkTapToBridge(const std::string & tap_name,const std::string & bridge_name)
methods.description: Links a tap interface to a bridge.

methods.name: bool CreateTap(const std::string & name)
methods.description: Creates and initializes a tap network interface.

methods.name: bool DeleteIface(const std::string & name)
methods.description: Deletes a network interface.

methods.name: bool DestroyIface(const std::string & name)
methods.description: Shuts down and deletes a network interface.

methods.name: std::optional<std::string> GetUserName(uid_t uid)
methods.description: Retrieves the username associated with a given user ID.

methods.name: bool CreateBridge(const std::string & name)
methods.description: Creates a network bridge interface.

methods.name: bool DestroyBridge(const std::string & name)
methods.description: Deletes a network bridge interface.

methods.name: bool SetupBridgeGateway(const std::string & bridge_name,const std::string & ipaddr)
methods.description: Configures IP gateway and DHCP for a bridge.

methods.name: void CleanupBridgeGateway(const std::string & name,const std::string & ipaddr,const GatewayConfig & config)
methods.description: Cleans up IP gateway and DHCP configurations for a bridge.

methods.name: bool StartDnsmasq(const std::string & bridge_name,const std::string & gateway,const std::string & dhcp_range)
methods.description: Starts a dnsmasq instance for DHCP and DNS services on a bridge.

methods.name: bool StopDnsmasq(const std::string & name)
methods.description: Stops the dnsmasq service for a bridge.

methods.name: bool IptableConfig(const std::string & network,bool add)
methods.description: Configures iptables SNAT MASQUERADE rule for network address translation.

methods.name: bool CreateEthernetBridgeIface(const std::string & name,const std::string & ipaddr)
methods.description: Creates an Ethernet bridge interface and configures gateway.

methods.name: bool DestroyEthernetBridgeIface(const std::string & name,const std::string & ipaddr)
methods.description: Destroys an Ethernet bridge and associated configurations.
